wins_analysis: No wins today. Both pending orders failed to trigger, meaning neither HDFCBANK nor TATASTEEL reached their specified entry prices during the session. Zero executions means the strategy generated no alpha but also preserved capital.
losses_analysis: No losses today either, but the real failure is zero execution — both orders expired unfilled. HDFCBANK SELL at 697.72 likely didn't rally enough to hit the sell entry in a strong down day (price may have gapped down and stayed below entry), while TATASTEEL BUY at 184.39 likely didn't pull back enough to fill. Entry prices were set too far from where price actually traded in a trending-down session.
regime_impact: The strong trending_down regime (Nifty -1.7%, ADX 25.0) actually hurt execution because SELL entries placed at supply zone resistance were never reached — in a strong downtrend, price gaps down and continues lower without retracing to supply. The regime correctly identified SELL as the right direction but the entry mechanism assumed a retracement that never came. Momentum-chase entries would have fit this regime better than zone-based limit orders.

improvements.action: When ADX >= 25 and regime is trending_down, place SELL limit orders 0.15-0.25% ABOVE current price instead of at the full supply zone level. In strong trends, retracements are shallow — adjust entry to capture smaller pullbacks.
improvements.reason: HDFCBANK SELL at 697.72 never triggered because in a -1.7% Nifty day, price likely opened weak and never retraced to the supply zone. Entry was too far above market.

improvements.action: Add a 'market order fallback' rule: if a SELL setup with AI prob >= 60% in a strong downtrend hasn't filled within the first 30 minutes, convert to market order or adjust limit to within 0.1% of current price.
improvements.reason: HDFCBANK had 62% probability and was trend-aligned — the highest conviction setup of the day — yet produced zero P&L because the limit order was too passive. Better to sacrifice a few points on entry than miss entirely.

improvements.action: Eliminate counter-trend BUY setups entirely when ADX >= 25 and regime is trending_down AND Nifty is down more than 1%. TATASTEEL BUY with 0% AI probability should never have been submitted as an order.
improvements.reason: TATASTEEL BUY had 0% AI probability and was counter-trend in a strong downtrend — this order wasted a slot and had virtually no chance of being a profitable trade even if filled. The pre-trade commentary correctly flagged it as too risky yet still placed the order.

improvements.action: Set minimum AI probability threshold to 50% for order placement. Do not convert recommendations with prob < 50% into actual pending orders.
improvements.reason: TATASTEEL had 0% AI probability yet was still placed as a pending order, contradicting the AI's own assessment. Enforce the AI signal as a hard filter, not just an advisory.

improvements.action: Expand the morning scan to include VWAP-based entries for trending days — look for stocks breaking below previous day's VWAP in the first 15 minutes as SELL entries, rather than relying solely on static supply/demand zones.
improvements.reason: Only 2 setups were found across all 50 Nifty stocks, and neither executed. Zone-based scanning is too restrictive in trending regimes. Adding momentum/VWAP criteria could surface 3-5 more actionable setups.

tomorrow_focus: If downtrend continues (watch for Nifty below today's low and ADX holding above 25), prioritize aggressive SELL entries on banking and IT stocks using tighter limit prices within 0.2% of market, and completely avoid counter-trend longs.
